title: Test a gate on one item bound to another held item through a target sighting recorded during the gate
outcome: Test a gate on one item bound to another held item through a target sighting recorded during the gate
acceptance: A fixture holds two claims A and B in one session, each with a named root in the same workspace. A passed native check is recorded on A. Before that check completes, an execution_observe records B's sighting at the check's revision with B's explicit binding. verification_bind for target B then succeeds and writes a bound record on B's run.

The same fixture shows that an accounted source change recorded on B's run AFTER A's check completed refuses B's bind as check_predates_unadmitted_change, and that an exact retry of a committed bind with the same key and identical request bytes replays the stored receipt.
An evaluation of B whose evidence basis includes the bound record cites it for a criterion bound to its check kind and passes; the test asserts the evaluation is admitted and not stale.

completion.summary: Added regression fixtures for explicit cross-item observation during a begun check, successful binding/replay and non-stale observed evaluation, plus rejection of observations recorded after check completion. Full gate12/12 passed; independent Codex/Claude review complete with Notes only; independent evaluation3/3 passed. Landed and installed tested commit; all five stores ready.
